question: How can repetition lead one to the supreme Shiva called Bhairava?
premises: One can go to the supreme Shiva named Bhairava even through repetition.
True repetition is of the same nature as that reality.
Such repetition has fallen away from the states of being and nonbeing.
inference: Repetition leads to Bhairava only when it is not mere verbal repetition but a practice aligned with a reality beyond being and nonbeing.
plain_english: One reaches the supreme Shiva called Bhairava even through repetition, but that repetition is truly of his nature and has moved beyond the oppositions of being and nonbeing.
